luiskr.com / core/utils/media / getGravatarSrcset

function getGravatarSrcset(urlStr): string;

Defined in: core/utils/media.ts:72

Builds responsive Gravatar srcset with 1x, 2x, 3x density descriptors — 200/300/400 px variants chosen by GRAVATAR_SIZE_*. Any existing size= param is stripped first so the rewrite is idempotent; sep picks ? or & depending on whether other query params remain (stripping size= may have consumed the ?).

Parameters

urlStr

string

Gravatar URL to expand.

Returns

string

srcset string, or '' for non-Gravatar input.
